title: What the Pallas's Cat sees

is_this_you.pressure: When trouble crosses the sky, you press flat and go still. The face says bored. Behind it you are counting.
is_this_you.love: You would rather move into a love that has already lasted a winter than dig a new one from nothing.
is_this_you.cost: People read your resting face as a verdict, and some never come close enough to hear the real one.

opener.text: Say its Chinese name, 兔猻 (tùsūn), and the Rabbit comes first [p3] [p4]. Nobody agrees how it got there [p5]. One account has herders shouting a Turkic word for “stop” [p5]. Another reads 兔 (tù) as “rabbit-sized” [p5]. Our China Story says flatly that the cat has nothing to do with rabbits [p6]. You were born a Scorpio in a Rabbit year. The name fits you anyway, and you would not explain it either.

tabs.label: The cold face
tabs.intro: Water underneath. Wood on top. A face that gives nothing.

rows.text: Scorpio is fixed Water, ruled by Mars of old and Pluto now, private and loyal for the long haul [p7] [p8]. The Rabbit is yin Wood, patient and kind, and keeps its thoughts to itself [p9] [p10]. Two guarded signs, stacked. You give away very little and miss almost nothing.
The manul's ears sit low on the sides of its head [p1]. It can look over a rock while showing very little of itself [p1]. You do the same in conversation. Half your face stays behind the stone.

Those low ears and round eyes give it a famously grumpy face [p1] [p2]. Jan Janecka told Mongabay the expression is “almost like a meme” [p2]. A 2008 Russian meme made it famous, and Moscow Zoo took it as a mascot in 2012 [p1]. Your face has been misread for longer than that.

tabs.label: Patience
tabs.intro: Wait at the den mouth. Move once.

rows.text: When danger passes overhead, the manul flattens itself and holds still [p2]. It hunts by ambush, at dawn and dusk in summer and often by day in autumn [p1] [p2]. You can outwait almost anything. The risk is staying flat long after the hawk has gone.
It sleeps in old fox dens, marmot burrows and rock crevices [p2]. You trust a shelter that has already proved itself. You are rarely wrong about which ones have.

Collared males in central Mongolia ranged over as much as 207 square kilometres [p1]. Each cat lived alone outside the mating season [p1]. Your people are spread wide and seen rarely. They are still yours.

Researchers mostly meet the manul by accident, on cameras set for snow leopards [p2]. China Highlights lists medicine among Rabbit careers [p10]. Fieldwork, audit and investigation suit you too, any job where being unseen is the skill.

tabs.label: Who gets close
tabs.intro: Three who can tell a still face from a shut heart. One who cannot.
tabs.love_lead: Scorpio opens slowly and then commits for years [p7] [p8]. The Rabbit is loyal to the few close to it [p10]. You need someone who can sit on the rock beside you and say nothing. Three animals share your rhythm.

easy.why: The Capybara (Cancer, Pig year) shares your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Cancer is Water like you [p11] [p7].
The Ghost Pipefish (Pisces, Goat year) is trine kin too, and Pisces makes the third Water sign [p11] [p7].
The Ribbon Seal (Cancer, Dog year) is your secret friend, since the Dog is the Rabbit's Six Harmonies partner [p11].

hard.why: The Superb Bird of Paradise (Taurus, Rooster year) is all display to your all cover: the Rooster clashes with the Rabbit, and Taurus sits opposite Scorpio [p11] [p7].

story.text: In the Vietnamese zodiac, the Cat sits where the Rabbit would [p9]. The Gurung zodiac makes the same swap [p9]. In those calendars, your year was a cat's year all along.

closing: Let them call the face grumpy. You had the whole steppe in view while they were deciding.
